lens: Skeptic. Fabrics compared at matched physical scale with the 0.43 m seat width as the ruler: q15 at x0.63 against y_47300 at x1.0, e4 at x0.81 against y_47306, and q16 at x1.0 against y_47301. Measured: box mean, B/R, luminance p10/p50/p90, column CV, and fleck coverage (pixels above 1.4x the median) with fleck/ground L and colours. Official photos decide colour; in-flight photos decide geometry (no new downloads). Renders are of b9489fe (rc8 / sc8). Scratch files are in /tmp/claude-0/rater17A/ (st.py, fl.py, q15cmp.png, tick.png).

priorIssues.issue: w16a-1 / w15a-1 petal fleck vanishes at row distance; too dense and soft close up
priorIssues.status: largely fixed at row distance; still too dense close up, and too blue and too round
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seats 2/4 at x0.63: coverage 0.16/0.17 (w16 0.08) vs y_47300 0.21; fleck/ground 1.78/1.80 (w16 1.76) vs 2.23/2.24; fleck colour #415385 B/R 2.05 vs #5b6994 B/R 1.62; ground #222d55 vs #202f59 (ground now right). q16 near crown: coverage 0.16 vs 0.27, fleck/ground 2.04 vs 2.34, fleck #7a8bb6 B/R 1.49 vs #8b92b1 B/R 1.27 (the whitish-grey problem is gone). Close up, the e4 pad L: coverage 0.30 vs y_47306 0.13-0.25, fleck/ground 1.98 vs 2.35. The flecks are round dots of uniform size, where y_47306 has elongated, irregular petals.

The vertical post at the pivot still reads as a separate member.

issues.title: Tick columns still break into speckle at row distance (colCV 0.06-0.08 vs 0.24)
issues.evidence: tick.png; q15 seats 1/3 at x0.63: colCV 0.077/0.062, p10/p50 0.57 vs y_47300 0.24, 0.44. Third round without movement: the w17 profile lift did not change the metric.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py tick tile: add a continuous dark channel between chain columns, ~25-30 % darker than the ground, at least 2 texels at mip 2 (about 4-5 mm), and make the pale strokes vertically continuous (no gaps longer than about 1 stroke). Alternatively, bias the tick layer's mip by -0.5 to -1. Target q15 colCV >= 0.15, p10/p50 <= 0.50.

issues.title: Headrest cover head-on still too light and grey, brightest on the middle seats
issues.evidence: q15 middle covers #3f455c L70 B/R 1.44 vs y_47300 #1e243c L37 B/R 2.00 and #272d48 L47 1.83. The outer covers are L51. The photo is darkest in the centre, so the render's centre brightening is view-dependent specular, not the albedo.
issues.fix: SEATMAT yCover: base about #1f2540 (B/R ~1.9) and cut the head-on specular (raise roughness to ~0.6, or lower F0 to ~0.03), keeping a grazing sheen for y_47306 / y_47301. Target q15 cover L 40-50, B/R >= 1.8. Also add the cover's details from y_47306: a stitched hem ~1.5 cm above the lower edge, a ~4 mm edge thickness and the small wing logo at the lower right.

issues.title: Petal fleck: flecks too blue at distance, too dense close up, and round instead of petal-shaped
issues.evidence: q15 fleck colour #415385 B/R 2.05 vs y_47300 #5b6994 B/R 1.62; fleck/ground 1.78 vs 2.23. e4 pad coverage 0.30 vs y_47306 0.13-0.25. In y_47306 the flecks are elongated, irregular petals of varying size. The render's are uniform round dots, which read as a snow-dot print in q16 / e4.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: desaturate the fleck cores toward #8090bc (B/R ~1.5), raise their L ~15 %, cut the count ~25 %, and stretch them ~1.6:1 at random angles with a +/-40 % size spread. Target q15 fleck/ground >= 2.1 with coverage held at ~0.18-0.21.

issues.title: Armrest J is a thin round tube; the real arm is a broad flat moulding
issues.evidence: e7_arm.png vs y_47303: the render tube is ~2 cm round. The photo arm support is a flat light-grey panel ~5-6 cm wide in side view that curves from the pad front down and back under the pad (a closed C/J), with no separate post.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: sweep a rounded rectangle about 5.5 x 2.5 cm (wide side in the seat's side plane) instead of the round tube, merge the pivot post into the bottom of the sweep, colour #cfd2d6.

issues.title: White shell-side sliver between the backs head-on (~5 cm)
issues.evidence: q15 seat 1 right edge: ~23 of 215 px. y_47300: ~8 of 130 px.
issues.fix: As w15a-5: inset the shell side flange ~3 cm behind the fabric edge, or narrow it.

issues.title: Seat pans all tick; y_47300 shows mosaic pans on some seats
issues.evidence: y_47300 bottom: seats 3/4 pans are dash mosaic (dark blocks); the render pans are all tick.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: give the pan the cycle's mosaic on about every other seat.

issues.title: Pillow has no seam or pinched corners
No lower-bezel indicator dots on the screen
issues.evidence: q18 vs y_47305: 4-5 small dots on the lower border.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: add 4-5 small dark-grey dots on the lower bezel.

issues.title: Fabric smears at grazing angles on the back sides
issues.evidence: q18 left back side: the fabric is a blurred blue wash, while in y_47305 the side weave stays crisp.
issues.fix: Enable anisotropic filtering (EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic, 8x) on the fabric layers. Not scored.

issues.title: QA cameras still do not match their reference photos
issues.evidence: q15 is higher and closer than y_47300 (no armrests or pillows in frame, so the covers look taller). q16 and q17 are framed differently from y_47301 and y_47303. Not scored.
issues.fix: test/qa.js: re-aim to the photo viewpoints.
